title: Peppol BIS Billing 3.0: the UBL invoice and credit note Norway, Denmark, Finland, the UK, Belgium, the Netherlands, Austria and Ireland receive
source: Peppol BIS Billing 3.0, release 3.0.21 (published 2026-05-20, mandatory from 2026-08-17): CEN-EN16931-UBL.sch (SHA-256 268d4f7a2688) and PEPPOL-EN16931-UBL.sch (SHA-256 62e5b67892f1) as docs.peppol.eu publishes them, with the national rules NO-R-001, NO-R-002 (Norway, EHF), DK-R-002 to DK-R-017 (Denmark) and NL-R-001 to NL-R-009 (the Netherlands), and PEPPOL-COMMON-R043 for the Belgian enterprise number under 0208. Belgium makes this format the rule between its businesses from 1 January 2026 (Royal Decree no. 1 art. 13ter). Erhvervsstyrelsen's document strategy of 5 March 2026 drops OIOUBL 3.0 for a Peppol-based Nemhandel BIS 4 from 2028-2029, so Peppol BIS 3 is the Danish format to write today. Read 2026-10-09.

rules.text: The official Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 rules (CEN EN 16931 UBL and PEPPOL, with the Norwegian, Danish and Dutch rules) accept the UBL beside the page; skipped when they are not installed.
